home.title: Dresses for rent in Barwani
home.body: Wedding and festival outfits from local shops, sent straight to their WhatsApp. Opening soon.

login.title: Your shop's dresses, online
login.body: Sign in with Google to show your dresses to people in Barwani. It's free.
login.note: The first time, we check your mobile number with a code. After that, one tap signs you in.
login.failed: Google sign-in didn't finish. Try again.

phone.title: Your mobile number
phone.body: We send a 6-digit code by SMS. You only do this once.
phone.label: Mobile number
phone.invalid: Enter a 10-digit number that starts with 6, 7, 8 or 9.
phone.wrongCode: That code didn't match. Check the SMS and try again.

onboarding.title: Tell us about your shop
onboarding.body: Shoppers see these details. We check every shop before it goes live.
onboarding.addressHelp: Only used to give shoppers directions.
onboarding.invalidPhone: Enter a 10-digit number that starts with 6, 7, 8 or 9.
onboarding.failed: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.

seller.pendingBody: We have {shop}'s details. We usually check within a day. You can add dresses once it's approved.
seller.suspendedBody: {shop} is hidden from shoppers right now. Contact the Rentals team to fix this.
seller.emptyBody: Adding dresses opens in the next update.
